mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community (user_id, title, content, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM community ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.title, c.created_at, COUNT(cl.id) AS like_count FROM community c LEFT JOIN community_like cl ON c.id = cl.community_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
